References are this project's original card paintings: match their coarse thick digital oil/impasto brushwork, desaturated dark charcoal/deep brown palette, northern knotwork materials, upper-left key light and heroic slightly low-angle half-length portrait. NOT pixel art, NOT photography, no glossy3D. Face and ALL identifying objects in upper55%; top of head near y8-12%, face around y18-30%, hands above y48%; bottom40% very dark plain drapery/haze with minimal detail, reserved for text overlay. On the full-drawn bow grows ONE LARGE CRYSTALLINE ICE ARROW, brighter/larger triangular ice head with icy shaft, entire tip within x9% and y19%, bow upper tip y5%, lower tip y49%, nock near x64%,y28%. All weapon identifiers above y53%; do not let arrow merge with bow/hand. White-cyan #BFEBFF blizzard spirals behind shoulders and head, many broad snow streaks, dark mountains faint behind, stronger power than normal, face still readable.
